estimates.assumptions: 2 rashers/strips of streaky bacon; typical UK rasher ~30 g each, edible portion used as-is (no trimming assumed).
1 celery stick/stalk; standard medium stalk ~40 g edible portion after trimming ends.
1 medium carrot; typical edible peeled weight ~60 g.
Dry lasagne sheets as supplied in the 500 g package; standard dry pasta calorie density used (no cooking state change to calories).
400 ml crème fraîche; density ~0.975 g/ml yields ~390 g edible mass; typical full-fat crème fraîche density applied.
125 g mozzarella ball(s); given weight is used directly as edible portion (drained if in brine, but assumed fresh).
Basil leaves as topping/scattered; modest handful estimate ~5 g fresh edible leaves (to taste, not a full serving).
